content:
Beats is expanding its popular lineup of USB-C cables today with an all-new “Power Pink” color. “Because your charging cable deserves to be just as expressive as your playlist,” Beats says.

The new Power Pink cable from Beats is available in the following options:

USB-C to USB-C (1.5 m / 5 ft)

  • $18.99
  • Supports charging up to 60W
  • Supports data transfer at USB 2.0 rates

USB-C to USB-C (3 m / 10 ft)

  • $29.99
  • Supports charging up to 240W

USB-A to USB-C (1.5 m / 5 ft)

  • $18.99
  • Supports charging up to 15W on select iPhone and iPad models

Beats USB-C cables feature a woven design for added durability. Beats cables undergo thousands of hours of testing throughout the design and manufacturing process and are reinforced to help prevent fraying,” Beats examples. “Compatible with both Apple and Android devices, these braided cables are built for charging, syncing, audio, CarPlay, and data transfer.”

On Amazon right now, you can save up to 37% on Beats USB-C cables — including the 240W option.

The new Beats Power Pink USB-C cable will be available to order today from Apple’s website and at Apple Stores on July 8. It will also be available from Target starting July 12.
